header.title: VM and CT Management

intro.title: Find a VMID or CTID first
intro.body: Almost every command needs a numeric ID. Use qm list for VMs and pct list for containers. Replace <vmid> / <ctid> in the snippets with the actual ID before running.

destroyWarn.title: Destroy is irreversible
destroyWarn.bodyRich: qm destroy and pct destroy remove the guest configuration and its managed disk volumes. Do not assume that external or bind-mounted data is deleted. The CLI has no confirmation prompt by default. Back up any data you may need before running it; see Backup and Restore.

qmConfigTip.title: qm config vs editing the .conf file directly
qmConfigTip.bodyRich: qm config <vmid> and pct config <ctid> display configuration through Proxmox’s parsers. For normal changes, prefer qm set or the corresponding pct setter. Direct edits to /etc/pve/qemu-server/<vmid>.conf or /etc/pve/lxc/<ctid>.conf bypass the validation and locking in management commands; the file must still remain parseable. Stop the guest and keep a copy before manual repair. pmxcfs synchronises configuration across cluster nodes, not guest disk contents.
